name: rutevi
description: Jev routing for tasks and subagents in the current conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Route tasks and subagents with Jev.
interface.longDescription: Choose callable executors with Jev, complete work in the current conversation, or explicitly open a separate Herdr session. Requires the Rutevi CLI and a TypeSafe key.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Jev to choose an executor for this task and verify the result.
